message.content: Columbia University is an Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. It was founded in 1754 as King's College and became Columbia College in 1784 after the American Revolution. Today it is one of the world’s leading academic institutions, known for its rigorous undergraduate programs, distinguished graduate schools (including Columbia Law School, Columbia Business School, and the Mailman School of Public Health), and its strong emphasis on interdisciplinary research. The campus is situated primarily in Morningside Heights on Manhattan’s Upper West Side, with additional facilities in Washington Heights, Brooklyn, and other parts of the city.
